name: indahl-quote-check
description: Check every quotation in a draft, article or report against its source, word for word. Marks each VERBATIM, ALTERED, PARAPHRASE_IN_QUOTES, MISATTRIBUTED, NOT_FOUND or CANNOT_TELL with the source text beside it. Runs inside your session.
